Container.Name: finalarr
Container.Overview: Season-finale and season-complete notifier for Sonarr. Tells you once when new episodes are on disk, when the season finale has landed and when a season is complete (AniList cross-check for anime, split cours included). Telegram, Discord, Pushover, webhooks or any Apprise URL. Web UI in German and English. A project by abrechen2 (https://www.abrechen2.de/en/).

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Web UI, API and Sonarr webhook

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Required, at least 20 characters (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32). Also your login.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Required Fernet key that encrypts stored Sonarr keys and channel URLs. See docs/DEPLOY.md to generate one; keep it, changing it makes stored secrets unreadable.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional address you open Finalarr at; adds links to messages.
